searchText.title: Search Text
searchText.description: Words to look for, for example summer or clinic. Leave empty to list recent forms.

modifiedWithinDays.title: Modified Within Days
modifiedWithinDays.description: Only forms changed in the last N days. Leave empty for any time.

status.title: Status
status.description: Draft, Active, Inactive or Archived. Leave empty for all.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of forms to return. Defaults to 10.
